tools.name: list_pagination_skill_files
tools.title: List Pagination Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'pagination' skill, the platform's guidance for building long or growing lists in a React app - infinite scroll, load-more buttons, and searchable paged tables that accumulate results page by page. Call this when the user asks for a list, table, feed, or picker over data that needs paging, and when they name useIteratorPixel, useIteratorApi, limit/offset paging, hasMore, or debounced search. Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for a one-shot pixel fetch (usePixel, see the app-bootstrap skill) and not for choosing which pixel to run (see the database, room, and model skills).

project.title: project
project.description: The pagination skill (pagination). Always this value.

tools.name: read_pagination_skill_file
tools.title: Read Pagination Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'pagination' skill in full, for writing React list UIs over paged data with @semoss/sdk/react. Pass filePath exactly as list_pagination_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers choosing between useIteratorPixel (pixel with a total count) and useIteratorApi (REST or any promise, short-page detection), the stable-limit and deps-reset rules, update() for in-place row patches after mutations, enabled gating, an IntersectionObserver infinite-scroll sentinel, and debouncing search inputs that drive the deps.
